tools.name: source
tools.description: Read current source at a known path and inclusive line range.
tools.semantics: At most 400 lines and 64 KiB. Prepared complete-file windows need no confirmation read. Inspect actual returned range and truncation.

tools.name: base_source
tools.description: Read the pinned comparison base, including deleted or renamed old files.
tools.semantics: Same line bounds as source. Only available when the work has a pinned base; current and base coordinates are independent.

tools.name: outline
tools.description: Locate declarations, members and imports in one known current file.
tools.semantics: AST navigation only. Does not resolve inherited dispatch, follow imports or establish that a named guard applies.

tools.name: symbol
tools.description: Find declaration locations by their reported name.
tools.semantics: Locator only. Optional path filters the declaration file, not the importing caller. Class.member spelling does not resolve a member; empty or clipped results do not prove absence.

tools.name: definition
tools.description: Locate and read one unambiguous declaration, up to its first 120 lines.
tools.semantics: Broker convenience built from symbol plus source; not a native CLI subcommand. Ambiguity returns navigation only. source_complete=false leaves the unreturned body unread; follow returned ranges with source.

tools.name: references
tools.description: Find identifier text uses, scoped to one file or directory.
tools.semantics: Bounded textual matches, not resolved calls. Choose path OR path_prefix. Limits count occurrences. Read decisive code; previews and empty searches do not prove reachability or absence.

tools.name: paths
tools.description: Discover paths using a case-insensitive literal substring.
tools.semantics: Not a glob. Searches the investigation index; missing runtime or generated files may be outside that index. Read a known source path directly when available.

tools.name: guidance
tools.description: Load one additional trusted review guide by its offered catalog name.
tools.semantics: Only allowlisted files from the bound skill package. Guidance is instructions, never application evidence or a safety conclusion. Uses the existing round, query, byte and time budgets; no shell or arbitrary file read.

common: Every query includes tool, exact prompting review_id (null for change pass), purpose and arguments. Use relative forward-slash source paths. The strict wire shape includes optional path filters as null when unused and an explicit discovery limit (normally 20, maximum 100). Native/defaulted requests may omit those fields. Batch only already-known independent lookups; use their results before dependent reads. Budget ceilings are not spending targets. Only the controller finalizes and admits responses.
